research_notes: Blocked: official and party biographies, candidate profiles and direct event remarks establish work but not full-time nonpolitical durations.
Targeted early-career searches produced many same-name professionals; unrelated IT, construction and overseas teaching profiles were not imported.
Need school and printing employers, calendar intervals and hours. Summer factory employment is not multiplied into whole years. No omitted public/private work is converted to zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: resolved Danby office and title; captured university overlap of teaching and separate SKIF leadership.2014 campaign departure may be a break rather than permanent cessation; no exact date inferred.

School and printing employer searches, first-speech review and public professional-name searches remain inconclusive. Aluco construction managing director and overseas teaching/IT Josh Burns profiles are different people and rejected. Father’s30-year printing career is not the member’s duration.

Next evidence needed: school/payroll or public employment profile with dates/hours, printing-company identity and individual summer periods, Danby appointment and leave history. No gated-profile collection or outreach performed.

Third follow-up3October2026: current first-person member biography adds previously omitted basketball-coach and corporate-sector work after university. Separate undated spells preserve these claims without guessing employers, remuneration, hours or a publishing-company identity. Its post-graduation grouping conflicts with the prior university placement of teacher-aide work, so neither phrase is converted into a date. Targeted searches still did not resolve the school, printing/corporate employer, coaching organisation or Danby appointment/leave boundary. No headline totals changed.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: exact-phrase searches for the teacher-aide, printing factory/despatch, basketball-coaching and corporate work returned the member's current broad biography and later reporting only. No source named the school, printing or corporate employer, coaching organisation, dates, paid status or hours. Search results were heavily contaminated by unrelated same-name professionals and were rejected. The current biography's post-graduation grouping remains in tension with his first-speech statement placing teacher-aide work during university, so no calendar interval was inferred. Danby appointment/leave and early-job boundaries remain unresolved; no headline change.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added previously unrecorded Monash BA study using own2021 McKell report biography and ABC corroboration. McKell authorship is not assumed employment. Targeted printing/school/corporate searches returned broad biography and namesakes; father Phil’s industry career and sister’s packaging work are not the member’s employer or tenure. Coles Online and overseas publishing/IT profiles were rejected as unrelated. Summer factory spells and study/work chronology conflict remain unresolved. Next seek payroll/legal school and print employers, coaching pay and Danby leave boundaries.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: both-engine searches for the early printing/factory, teacher-aide, coaching, corporate and Danby employment again yielded broad existing chronology or unrelated same-name professionals. Mt Scopus alumni attendance does not establish employment at that school; theatre-camera credits, overseas public-service, fighter and IT profiles were rejected as different people. No named early employer, substantive hours, paid coaching terms or Danby appointment/leave boundary was recovered. Current biography versus first-speech study/work sequence remains unresolved. Further generic searches are exhausted; useful follow-up requires an original public professional CV, school/printing personnel material or Danby staffing record, with explicit pay/leave details. All supported facts retained; no numerical or status change.

Second targeted primary pass5October2026: checked alternate28June2022 Print21 PacPrint report; it describes personal packaging experience but names no employer, hours, paid contract or boundaries, so not split into an extra job beyond existing summer factory/despatch spell. Image magazine own quotation remains stronger detail; father30year print career and sister packaging still not attributed to member. Official2019 first-speech URL again returns403Forbidden; existing accessible reproduced first-person transcript retained. Danby2013 staffing and print/corporate-name searches return known election chronology and same-name professionals, not verified personal payroll or start. Original early-job employers, school, coaching pay and Danby leave/cessation remain unresolved; advance pending new personnel lead.
